label: memory of acquired stress resistance

rows.snippet: resistance persisted for four to five generations after cells were removed from the prior salt treatment
rows.locator: Scientific abstract; persistence result independently checked in Results, Methods, actual Figure 1 and S1/S2.
rows.limits: Four-to-five generations is the abstract statement; main Figure 1 describes three-to-four doublings over 360 minutes. Methods specifies 11 peroxide doses plus control, whereas Figure 1A captions ten plotted doses. Preserve these section-specific descriptions. The normalized survival score is not a fraction of memory-bearing cells. Main BY4741 background and engineered UCC8613 daughter-marking assays are separate. No natural canonical taxon or common molecular mechanism is asserted.

rows.snippet: the cells inheriting this ancestral PA displayed a significantly increased heat resistance compared to their isogenic, PA-free siblings.
rows.locator: Scientific abstract, not Author Summary; native heat-induced PA result checked in Results sec007, relevant Methods, actual Figure 4 and S6.
rows.limits: Engineered MG1655 IbpA-msfGFP reporters: 47 C for 15 minutes, growth recovery, then 51 C for 7 minutes. Figure 4C detects no improved population-average survival; Figure 4D compares aggregate-bearing and aggregate-free descendants. Survival requires growth and division within eight hours. S6 detects no age-bin difference in this assay, not universal age independence. Figure 4F illustrates a lineage, not a fixed duration for the whole trait. Synthetic induction experiments and their seven-to-eight-generation endpoint are not transferred to native heat-induced lineages. Raw data were not independently reanalyzed.

notice_limit: Publisher and MED/Crossref exposed no linked correction or retraction in the bounded checks. This is not exhaustive notice absence. Guan has a Crossref has-review relation, not an independent experiment or correction.

acceptance.decision: Accept memory of acquired stress resistance as a new first-pass PROPOSED microbial physiological class, subject to reservation checks and the full validation/review lifecycle.
acceptance.definition_boundary: Persistence of elevated resistance after an inducing stress has been removed, through a non-genetic state retained in a microbial cell or lineage.
acceptance.novelty_scope: Ignored and hidden available files in all 22 registered TraitMech roots and five known independent main copies; 18 retained historical tracked trees; normalized semantics across 1121 distinct trait versions; fresh seed projection and frozen release inventories; all open/draft TraitMech, CommunityMech and METPO PR file lists, relevant full blobs and all 20 changed METPO files; pinned/released/edit METPO RDF; current upstream CommunityMech proposals and KG-Microbe mappings/proposals; paginated METPO issues and comments.
acceptance.semantic_disposition: No exact record or active/deprecated memory class found in the inspected scope. Carbon-source memory bounds nutrient-history responses. Stress response denotes sensing/mounting protection, not specifically persistence after removal. Anticipation requires a cue-to-later-condition interpretation, not cross-protection alone. Aggregate inheritance describes allocation, not retained stress resistance. Tolerance classes and cold acclimation references do not require this history-dependent endpoint. Research-report preconditioning and cross-protection mentions are leads, not curated exact records or primary snippet sources.
acceptance.historical_metpo: METPO:1000293 obsolete stress response and METPO:1000222 obsolete oxidative stress response are deprecated broader lexical neighbors with an OMO:0001000 reason annotation and no replacement/consider in the inspected releases. They are not exact memory terms and are neither reactivated nor used as xrefs. METPO:1000059 phenotype is the conservative parent.
acceptance.evidence_limits: Guan peroxide-survival persistence and faster transcriptional reactivation are separate. Govers cell-level survival advantage does not imply improved population-average survival. Engineered reporter and daughter-marking contexts remain qualified; natural canonical taxa, universal mechanisms, exact synonyms and external equivalences are not asserted.
